# Cliner

> Cliner is a native, lightweight macOS application uninstaller built with Rust and GPUI. When you drag an application to the macOS Trash, gigabytes of hidden caches, preference plists, application support files, containers, and logs remain scattered across ~/Library. Cliner detects app deletions in real time and completely purges all leftover files in one click.

## Overview & Facts

- **Product Name**: Cliner (Cliner for Mac)
- **Official Website**: https://cliner.app
- **Full LLM Context**: https://cliner.app/llms-full.txt
- **Target OS**: macOS 13.0 (Ventura), macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) or later
- **Architecture**: Universal binary for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel x86_64
- **Tech Stack**: 100% Native Rust & GPUI (sub-10MB bundle, sub-150ms instant filesystem scan)
- **Pricing**: $3.00 USD one-time purchase. Lifetime access on all personal Macs. No subscriptions or renewals.
- **Payment & License Delivery**: Dodo Payments (instant license key and direct download)
- **Safety Model**: 100% reversible via native macOS Trash (Put Back supported)

## Key Features

- **1-Click Deep Cleanup**: Discovers and wipes Application Support, Caches, Preferences, Saved Application State, WebKit data, CrashReporter logs, and Sandbox Containers.
- **Automatic Trash Watcher**: Silently detects when an application is dragged to Trash and offers 1-click leftover purging.
- **Smart Update Detection**: Distinguishes app updates and reinstallations from genuine uninstalls so it never interrupts normal workflow.
- **Privacy & Offline First**: 100% local processing. No user analytics, no background telemetry, no cloud dependencies.
